title: DNA-binding, cleavage, antibacterial and in vitro anticancer activity of copper(II) mixed ligand complexes of 2-(((6-chloro-1H-benzo[d]imidazol-2-yl)methyl)amino)aceticacid and polypyridyl ligands.
authors: Sabithakala, Thatituri; Reddy, Chittireddy Venkata Ramana
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜(II)混合配体配合物的DNA结合与切割活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但对象为小分子配合物而非TF-DNA体系，且方法仅含分子对接预测，缺乏AI或物理模拟深度建模。
abstract: A tridentate ligand(A), 2-(((6-chloro-1H-benzo[d]imidazol-2-yl)methyl)amino) aceticacid (Cl-BIGH) was synthesised by the Phillips condensation of 4-chlorobenzene-1,2-diamine and iminodiaceticacid in 1:2 molar ratio. Its Cu(II) mixed ligand complexes[Cu(II)-A-L] were obtained by involving other co-ligands(L): 2,2΄-bipyridine(L(1)), 4,4΄-dimethyl-2,2΄-bipyridyl(L(2)), 5,5΄-dimethyl-2,2΄-bipyridyl(L(3)) and 1,10 phenanthroline(L(4)). The complexes were characterized by elemental analysis, thermal analysis, molar conductance, magnetic moment measurements, X-ray diffraction, FTIR, UV-Visible, ESR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry and cyclic voltammetry. From the spectral and analytical data, the ternary complexes [Cu(Cl-BIGH)(L(1-4))]ClO(4) were found to form in 1:1:1(Cu(II): Cl-BIGH: L) molar ratio. The geometry of the mixed-ligand complexes were found to be 5-coordinated square pyramidal or trigonal bipyramidal with polycrystalline natures. The DNA binding and cleaving abilities, antibacterial and the in vitro cytotoxicity of the complexes were explored. The molecular docking was used to predict the efficiency of binding of the metal complexes with COX- 2.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 通过Phillips缩合反应，以4-氯苯-1,2-二胺和亚氨基二乙酸按1:2摩尔比合成了一种三齿配体(A)，即2-(((6-氯-1H-苯并[d]咪唑-2-基)甲基)氨基)乙酸(Cl-BIGH)。通过引入其他辅助配体(L)：2,2΄-联吡啶(L(1))、4,4΄-二甲基-2,2΄-联吡啶(L(2))、5,5΄-二甲基-2,2΄-联吡啶(L(3))和1,10-菲咯啉(L(4))，获得了其Cu(II)混合配体配合物[Cu(II)-A-L]。通过元素分析、热分析、摩尔电导、磁矩测量、X射线衍射、FTIR、UV-Visible、ESR光谱、质谱和循环伏安法对配合物进行了表征。根据光谱和分析数据，三元配合物[Cu(Cl-BIGH)(L(1-4))]ClO(4)以1:1:1(Cu(II): Cl-BIGH: L)摩尔比形成。混合配体配合物的几何结构被确定为五配位方形锥体或三角双锥体，具有多晶性质。研究了配合物的DNA结合和切割能力、抗菌活性以及体外细胞毒性。分子对接用于预测金属配合物与COX-2的结合效率。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
